source_refs.quote: The first three-wave optimizations produced no separation candidates. A separate exact calculation also ruled out a proposed shortcut: a polynomial cubic correction cannot cancel the full acoustic heat columns for any nonzero cubic. This includes translated energies already known to be quasiconvex, so it is a failure of that correction form.

The correlation calculation gives a useful classification: eight explicit compatible fields detect every cubic direction beyond translation. Cubics whose correlation vanishes for every field are exactly the translation cubics. Thus the old translation argument covers precisely four of the twelve directions.
